newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares hit record highs, Forekspank leaps.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares hit record highs, Forekspank leaps.

text.p: Local buying pressure on the Tallinn stock exchange on Wednesday moved the market upward again with almost any news pushing prices higher, dealers said.
Total volume on the official list reached a high 67.5 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index continued to climb with a 2.75 percent increase to a new high of 231.44.
"The main force behind this drive appears to be local small investors who have some cash ready to buy almost anything," one dealer said.
"Foreign interest from Helsinki has cooled and it appears some selling pressure could come later in the week," he added.
Hoiupank was most traded with a volume of 21 million kroons of shares to end 5 kroons higher on 118.00 kroons.
Forekspank was also stronger with a volume of 13.0 million kroons of shares. The stock's price leapt 6.35 kroons to close on 163.40 kroons.
Hansapank saw 12.4 million kroons of shares changing hands to end a healthy 5.95 kroons higher on 232.45 kroons.
"Foreign interest in Estonian stocks from Helsinki decreased and this may flow on to the local bourse as well, affecting Hansapank," another trader said.
Hansapank shares in Helsinki rose two markka to 88 markka on trade of just 15.
Uhispank was 0.50 kroons higher to close on 45.85 kroons after a trade of 8.8 million kroons of shares but in Helsinki it lost 0.10 markka to 16.90 markka.
Tallinna Pank continued its upward climb to close at 70.00 kroons, 0.91 kroons higher after 7.7 million kroons of shares changed hands.
Tallinna Pharma steamed 4.67 kroons higher to close on 122.17 kroons on turnover of 4.4 million kroons of shares.
On the free market, 5.2 million kroons of shares were traded with diversified industrialist Norma the most active and department store Tallinna Kaubamaja following closely.
Norma's stocks were fuelled by its good results from the beginning of the year and it rose 0.65 kroons to close on 65.45.
Tallinna Kaubamaja traded 1.5 million kroons of shares to end 0.25 kroons up on 84.50 kroons.
